reconstructed_insights: The important object is not 'a waveform ring'. It is a reversible projection of a song into an addressed temporal field.
Custom-song mapping becomes useful when analysis produces durable evidence (AUDIO MAP + source hash) and interaction uses multiple temporal apertures rather than a decorative amplitude visualizer.

A song can lend clock, density, energy and sectional context while each instrument retains its own transformation grammar. This prevents audio-reactivity from flattening everything into one visualization.
FIELD PULSE is the missing connective tissue: tiny live envelopes connect LISTEN, LIVE, RSVP and TWO DIAL without creating another dashboard/hub or moving canonical authority.

The same song can therefore be projected differently: RSVP receives pace; LIVE receives beat/track witnesses; TWO DIAL receives optional metrical context; future rhythm-game exports receive beat/event tapes.
RETURN remains the proof boundary: live pulse is ephemeral; AUDIO MAP/source hash and instrument exports are durable.
Scope is operational, not cosmetic: BEAT→PHRASE→SECTION→TRACK changes the address space in which scrubbing/attention occurs.
